name: experiment
description: Agentic access to the sollertia-experiment library: the system-agnostic core for acquisition system design, hardware interfaces, runtime patterns, and session lifecycle management on the experiment host. System-specific skills live in dedicated companion plugins (e.g. the 'mesoscope' plugin for the Mesoscope-VR reference system). Backed by the single sollertia-experiment MCP server (sle mcp), which exposes the tools behind the `sle get` and `sle mesoscope` command groups.
